personality: Arcanine has been admired for its grace for generations, and Chinese legend treats it as a majestic runner. Its Pokédex says it can cover more than 6,200 miles in a single day and night without slowing its pace. A centuries-spanning picture scroll shows people stopping just to watch it run across open prairies. The fire that burns inside it is said to be the true source of all that speed.

media.note: Arcanine appears across the anime as the other common partner Pokémon for Officer Jenny, alongside Growlithe.

community: Arcanine is a frequent pick in fan talk about the best legendary-looking Pokémon without actual Legendary status, and its line about running 6,200 miles in a day is one of the most quoted Pokédex stats in the series.
